# Scrapers.tech — 39 Production Web Scrapers & AI MCP Tools Fleet

> HTTP-first web intelligence and scraping infrastructure published on the Apify Store by @laborious_rumor. Engineered for sub-5 second execution, zero cookie dependencies, and Pay-Per-Event micro-pricing ($0.002 - $0.004 / record).

## Core Capabilities
- Model Context Protocol (MCP) server support for Claude Desktop, Cursor, ChatGPT, and LangChain.
- Automated B2B lead enrichment, e-commerce price monitoring, job board tracking, and social media analytics.
- Output exports supported in JSON, CSV, Excel, XML, and live Webhook endpoints.
